_premiums_legend: d=DL (double letter), t=TL (triple letter), D=DW (double word), T=TW (triple word), .=plain. Multipliers apply only to squares a NEW tile is placed on.

All four replayed move scores (30, 18, 53, 33) are exact under this map - run engine.py --selftest.
